title: Testing with pytest & unittest
intro: Python testing interview questions for freshers focus on whether you understand why tests exist and whether you can write a simple one — not whether you've mastered pytest fixtures and parametrize. This page covers the testing vocabulary every fresher needs (unit test, integration test, the test pyramid at the concept level), the unittest module from the standard library (TestCase, test methods, setUp, tearDown, assert methods), pytest as the modern alternative (how it finds tests automatically, why assert statements feel simpler than unittest's assertX methods), the mocking concept (replacing a real database call or API call with a fake during tests — why you do this, what unittest.mock.MagicMock does at a basic level), test naming conventions (test_ prefix, descriptive names), and the question that separates candidates who actually write tests from those who just know the syntax: 'what would you test first for a function that validates a user email?'
